label: CIRCIA
statusNote: Final rule not published as of 2026-10-28. CISA missed the October 2025 statutory date and later targets; secondary reporting says it went to OMB review in October 2026. Values are from the April 2024 proposed rule and may change.

triggers.label: Reasonably believes a covered cyber incident occurred
triggers.hint: The 72-hour clock starts when the entity reasonably believes a covered incident occurred.

triggers.label: Ransom payment made
triggers.hint: The 24-hour clock starts when the ransom is paid.

clocks.label: Covered cyber incident report
clocks.rule: Report a covered cyber incident to CISA within 72 hours (proposed rule).

clocks.label: Ransom payment report
clocks.rule: Report a ransom payment to CISA within 24 hours of paying (proposed rule).

appliesTo.note: Covered entities in critical infrastructure sectors (as the final rule defines them).
